infobox.effect: Provides 16 inventory slots while only taking up 1

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Info
sections.text: The Key tool is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 16 inventory slots in a 4x4 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. Only Keys can be stored in it.

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- At the three-story dorms in the "marked room"
- On a industrial shelf in warehouse 3 at the shipping yard

- "Old Gas Station":

  - At the "giving tree" behind it

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - In the "marked rooms" RB-BK, RB-PKPM and RB-VO
